blocks.heading: Four Questions Before You Pick One

items.text: Eight categories, wide pay bands, and a scarce-versus-crowded split is still a lot to hold in your head at once.
Do you focus best alone on a technical problem for hours, or do you get energy from talking to people and switching contexts often.
Are you a student with a lighter semester, a working professional with two spare hours a day, or someone who needs income within a few months.

blocks.heading: Avoid When Chasing a "High Salary" Skill

items.text: A senior AI architect's Rs 40 LPA salary is not what a fresher earns in year one.
A certificate proves attendance, not capability.
The best model, dashboard, or campaign in the world is worth less if you cannot explain it clearly to a manager, client, or interviewer.

blocks.heading: Genuinely Scarce Versus What Is Oversaturated

items.text: Basic prompting with no domain judgment behind it.
Generic social media posting and content writing with no strategy or measurable result.
Certificate-only resumes with no real project behind the certificate.
Template dashboards and reports that any AI tool can now generate in seconds.
Entry-level data entry, market research, and basic report generation, which over 30% of Indian organisations are actively reducing hiring for as AI absorbs this work.
The degree is only one part of income growth.
